svg.title: CryptoPulse MQTT · Signal Watch
svg.desc: A miniature IoT security station. Mint MQTT traffic goes through a locked broker. An RF receiver passes signal activity to an Arduino Uno R4, where an artificial neural network detects an anomaly. An amber alert appears on the dashboard, alongside the model’s 91% evaluation accuracy.

g.aria-label: Separate MQTT and RF signal routes
Monitor status and received RF signal
Arduino Uno R4 running the RF detection neural network
